model.title: Ratepayer Protection Act
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. Gabe Evans (R-CO)

summary.text: The bill would require state utility regulators to consider adopting a standard that makes large data centers and similar high-demand facilities pay the full cost of any power plant, transmission line, or distribution upgrades needed to serve them, including costs if the customer later leaves. These "large-load customers" would need to provide financial guarantees or upfront payments to cover upgrade expenses before utilities proceed with any infrastructure work.
